label: Tooltip

accessibility.rule: Tooltip uses role=tooltip and merges its ID with the trigger existing aria-describedby IDs. Icon triggers require their own accessible name.
Keyboard focus opens immediately. Escape, blur and activation close without leaveDelayMs; focus remains on the trigger.
Tooltip stays open over its trigger or content and while keyboard focus remains. leaveDelayMs applies only to pointer departure.
Tooltip content has no focusable controls. Required information and disabled reasons must also be available without a tooltip.

notes: Events are framework-specific and omitted from this contract.
This props list covers Tooltip root; the current React contract parser does not validate inherited or companion-slot props.
enterDelayMs overrides deprecated delay; omission inherits TooltipProvider enterDelayMs (default 500ms). Keyboard focus is not delayed.
TooltipProvider supports enterDelayMs (500ms) and skipDelayMs (300ms), with existing delayDuration/skipDelayDuration aliases retained.
TooltipContent supports position (12 positions, default top), arrow (false), offset (8), and transition (enter 140ms/out 100ms).
Content uses rounded-md (4px). Dark theme uses background-neutral-strong and text-on-color, including locally themed triggers rendered through a Portal.
